examples.source: This book was originally written in French by the author.
examples.target: 這本書最初是由作者用法的寫成的。

examples.source: Many popular sports originate in countries across the world.
examples.target: 許多受歡迎的運動都起源於世界各地的國家。

examples.source: This traditional festival is said to originate in ancient times.
examples.target: 據說這個傳統節日起源於古代。

examples.source: These beautiful patterns originate in a small village in Japan.
examples.target: 這些美麗的圖案起源於日本的一個小村莊。

examples.source: She bought a beautiful glass ornament for the Christmas tree.
examples.target: 她買了一個漂亮的玻璃裝飾品掛在聖誕樹上。

examples.source: This small ornament makes the living room look much better.
examples.target: 這個小小的裝飾品讓客廳看起來好看多了。

examples.source: We placed a golden ornament on the table as a decoration.
examples.target: 我們在桌上放了一個金色裝飾品作為點綴。

examples.source: The young orphan lived in a small house with his aunt.
examples.target: 這名年輕的孤兒與他的阿姨住在小屋裡。

examples.source: Many people donated money to help the orphan after the accident.
examples.target: 意外發生後，許多人捐錢幫助這名孤兒。

examples.source: The orphan felt happy when he found a new family.
examples.target: 當這名孤兒找到新家庭時，他感到很開心。

examples.source: Other than reading books, I also enjoy playing basketball.
examples.target: 除了閱讀書籍之外，我還喜歡打籃球。

examples.source: There is no one here other than my best friend.
examples.target: 除了我最好的朋友之外，這裡沒有其他人。

examples.source: I have no plans other than finishing my homework today.
examples.target: 除了今天完成功課之外，我沒有其他計劃。

examples.source: You should always be kind to others at school.
examples.target: 在學校，你應該對其他人友善。

examples.source: Please do not copy the work of others.
examples.target: 請不要抄襲其他人的功課。

examples.source: I prefer to play games with others than alone.
examples.target: 比起獨自一人，我更喜歡與其他人一起玩遊戲。

examples.source: You ought to finish your homework before playing video games.
examples.target: 你應該在玩電子遊戲前完成功課。

examples.source: We ought to help our classmates when they have difficulties.
examples.target: 當同學遇到困難時，我們應該幫助他們。

examples.source: She ought to go to bed early if she feels tired.
examples.target: 如果她感到疲倦，她應該早點睡覺。

examples.source: You ought to finish your homework before playing video games.
examples.target: 你應該在玩電子遊戲前完成功課。

examples.source: We ought to help our classmates when they have problems.
examples.target: 當同學遇到困難時，我們應該幫助他們。

examples.source: Students ought to listen carefully when the teacher is speaking.
examples.target: 老師說話時，學生應該留心聆聽。

examples.source: That big house on the corner is ours.
examples.target: 角落那間大屋是我們的。

examples.source: We should share our toys because this room is ours.
examples.target: 我們應該分享玩具，因為這個房間是我們的。

examples.source: If you find a blue bag, it is ours.
examples.target: 如果你找到一個藍色袋子，那是我們的。

outcry.meaning: 強烈抗議 / 強烈反對

examples.source: There was a public outcry when the school canteen closed.
examples.target: 學校飯堂結業時，引起了公眾的強烈抗議。

examples.source: The new rule caused an outcry among the angry students.
examples.target: 這條新校規在憤怒的學生之間引起了強烈反對。

examples.source: If they cut the sports budget, there will be an outcry.
examples.target: 如果他們削減體育預算，將會引發強烈抗議。

examples.source: This computer is outdated, so I need to buy a new one.
examples.target: 這部電腦已經過時了，所以我需要買一部新的。

examples.source: Many people think that wearing a tie is now outdated.
examples.target: 很多人認為打領帶現在已經過時了。

examples.source: The information in this book is outdated and not very useful.
examples.target: 這本書裡的資訊已經過時，不太實用了。

examples.source: We enjoy doing outdoor activities when the weather is nice.
examples.target: 天氣好的時候，我們很喜歡進行戶外活動。

examples.source: The school has a large outdoor playground for the students.
examples.target: 學校有一個很大的戶外操場供學生使用。

examples.source: You should wear a hat if you stay in outdoor areas.
examples.target: 如果你留在戶外地方，就應該戴上一頂帽子。

examples.source: We usually play football outdoors when the weather is nice.
examples.target: 天氣好的時候，我們通常會在戶外踢足球。

examples.source: It is much healthier to exercise outdoors than in the gym.
examples.target: 在戶外運動比在健身房運動健康得多。

examples.source: You should wear a hat if you stay outdoors for long.
examples.target: 如果你在戶外待太久，就應該戴上一頂帽子。

outgoing.meaning: 外向的 / 友善健談的

examples.source: She is very outgoing and makes new friends easily at school.
examples.target: 她性格很外向，在學校很容易結交新朋友。

examples.source: He has an outgoing personality, so he enjoys joining group activities.
examples.target: 他性格外向，所以很喜歡參加小組活動。

examples.source: You should be more outgoing if you want to meet people.
examples.target: 如果你想認識新朋友，就應該表現得更外向一點。

outrageous.meaning: 荒謬的 / 令人震驚的

examples.source: It is outrageous that the shop charges so much for water.
examples.target: 這間店賣的水收費這麼貴，實在太荒謬了。

examples.source: The price of this simple toy is absolutely outrageous.
examples.target: 這個簡單玩具的價格簡直是荒謬得離譜。

examples.source: He told an outrageous lie when the teacher asked him why.
examples.target: 當老師問他原因時，他撒了一個令人震驚的謊。

outrageous.meaning: 離譜的 / 令人震驚的

examples.source: The price was outrageous.
examples.target: 價格離譜。

examples.source: His claim sounded outrageous at first.
examples.target: 他的說法起初聽起來令人震驚。

examples.source: The costume was colourful and outrageous.
examples.target: 服裝色彩鮮明而誇張。

examples.source: The company decided to outsource its cleaning work to save money.
examples.target: 公司決定將清潔工作外判，以節省開支。

examples.source: We outsource our IT support because we lack the technical staff.
examples.target: 因為缺乏技術人員，我們將資訊科技支援工作外判。

examples.source: If the project is too big, the firm will outsource it.
examples.target: 如果項目規模太大，這間公司便會將其外判。

examples.source: She is an outspoken student who always shares her ideas in class.
examples.target: 她是一位敢言的學生，總是在課堂上分享自己的想法。

examples.source: He is outspoken, so he tells people exactly what he thinks.
examples.target: 他為人直言，所以總會直接說出心裡的想法。

examples.source: Being outspoken helps her stand up for herself when things go wrong.
examples.target: 敢言的性格讓她在遇到問題時，懂得為自己發聲。

examples.source: The benefits of exercise outweigh the risks of injury.
examples.target: 運動的好處大於受傷的風險。

examples.source: The advantages of this plan outweigh the disadvantages.
examples.target: 這個計劃的優點比缺點更重要。

examples.source: Her hard work will outweigh her lack of experience.
examples.target: 她的努力將會勝過她經驗不足的問題。

examples.source: The mechanic will overhaul the old engine to make it safer.
examples.target: 技工將會徹底檢修這台舊引擎，令它變得更安全。

examples.source: We need to overhaul our study plan if we want better grades.
examples.target: 如果我們想取得更好成績，就需要徹底檢修我們的讀書計劃。

examples.source: The school decided to overhaul the computer system during the summer.
examples.target: 學校決定在暑假期間徹底檢修電腦系統。

examples.source: The old train station needs a complete overhaul this year.
examples.target: 這個舊火車站今年需要一次全面大檢修。

examples.source: The computer system worked better after the overhaul.
examples.target: 電腦系統在大檢修後運作得更好。

examples.source: The school planned an overhaul of the library during summer.
examples.target: 學校計劃在暑假為圖書館進行大檢修。

overhaul.meaning: 徹底檢修 / 全面改革

examples.source: The government plans to overhaul the public transport system to reduce traffic congestion.
examples.target: 政府計劃徹底檢修公共交通系統，以紓緩交通擠塞。

examples.source: We need to overhaul our marketing strategy if we want to reach more young customers.
examples.target: 如果我們想接觸更多年輕客戶，就必須全面改革營銷策略。

examples.source: The mechanic had to overhaul the engine after the car broke down on the highway.
examples.target: 汽車在公路上拋錨後，技工必須為引擎進行徹底檢修。

overhaul.meaning: 徹底檢修 / 全面改革

examples.source: The government is planning a major overhaul of the education system.
examples.target: 政府正計劃對教育制度進行全面改革。

examples.source: The old engine needs a complete overhaul before it can be used again.
examples.target: 這台舊引擎在重新使用前，需要進行徹底檢修。

examples.source: The company underwent an organizational overhaul to improve its efficiency.
examples.target: 該公司進行了組織架構的全面改革，以提升效率。

examples.source: The shop closed because the monthly overhead was too high.
examples.target: 因為每月的經常開支太高，那間店舖結業了。

examples.source: We need to cut our overhead to save more money.
examples.target: 我們需要削減雜費，以便節省更多金錢。

examples.source: High overhead makes it difficult for small businesses to succeed.
examples.target: 高昂的經常開支令小型企業難以成功。

overhead.meaning: 間接成本 / 經常開支

examples.source: The company needs to cut its overhead to save more money.
examples.target: 公司需要削減經常開支以節省更多金錢。

examples.source: High overhead makes it difficult for small shops to survive today.
examples.target: 高昂的間接成本令小店現時很難生存。

examples.source: We must consider the overhead when we plan our new business.
examples.target: 我們計劃新業務時必須考慮到經常開支。

examples.source: The bright lights overhead made it difficult for me to read my book.
examples.target: 頭頂上方的強光令我難以閱讀書本。

examples.source: We looked up at the birds flying overhead in the clear blue sky.
examples.target: 我們抬頭看著頭頂上方在藍天中飛翔的鳥兒。

examples.source: The overhead fan kept the classroom cool during the hot summer afternoon.
examples.target: 在炎熱的夏日下午，頭頂上方的風扇讓課室保持涼爽。

examples.source: A bright moon was shining high overhead in the dark night sky.
examples.target: 一輪明月高掛在漆黑的夜空中。

examples.source: We heard a loud plane flying overhead while we were at school.
examples.target: 我們在學校時，聽到一架飛機在頭頂上方飛過。

examples.source: The bright lights were glowing overhead in the middle of the classroom.
examples.target: 課室中央的燈光在我們頭頂上方亮著。

overhead.meaning: 經常開支 / 間接成本

examples.source: The company is trying to reduce its monthly overhead to stay profitable.
examples.target: 公司正嘗試削減每月經常開支，以維持盈利。

examples.source: High rent is a major part of our business overhead.
examples.target: 高昂的租金是我們營運成本中的一大部分。

examples.source: We need to keep our overhead low to compete with larger firms.
examples.target: 我們必須保持低間接成本，才能與大型企業競爭。

examples.source: The shop owner needs to pay high monthly overheads.
examples.target: 店主每月需要支付高昂的經常開支。

examples.source: We must reduce our overheads to save more money.
examples.target: 我們必須減少雜費，以節省更多金錢。

examples.source: High overheads make it difficult to run a small business.
examples.target: 高昂的經常開支令經營小生意變得困難。

examples.source: I happened to overhear them talking about the surprise party.
examples.target: 我剛好無意中聽到他們在談論驚喜派對。

examples.source: She tried not to overhear the private conversation in the library.
examples.target: 她試著不去無意中聽到圖書館裡的私人對話。

examples.source: I overheard my teacher saying that the exam is next week.
examples.target: 我無意中聽到老師說考試就在下星期。

overjoyed.meaning: 非常高興的 / 狂喜的

examples.source: She was overjoyed when she heard that she passed the exam.
examples.target: 當她聽到自己考試及格時，感到非常高興。

examples.source: The children were overjoyed because they were going to the park.
examples.target: 孩子們因為要去公園玩而感到非常高興。

examples.source: He was overjoyed to receive a birthday gift from his friend.
examples.target: 他收到朋友送的生日禮物，感到非常高興。

overpriced.meaning: 價格過高的 / 太貴的

examples.source: This restaurant is overpriced, so we decided to eat elsewhere.
examples.target: 這間餐廳價格過高，所以我們決定去別處吃飯。

examples.source: I think these shoes are overpriced for such poor quality.
examples.target: 我覺得這雙鞋品質這麼差，賣得太貴了。

examples.source: The souvenir was overpriced because it was sold at the airport.
examples.target: 那件紀念品因為在機場販售，所以價格過高。

examples.source: My brother is studying overseas because he wants to learn more.
examples.target: 我哥哥正在海外留學，因為他想學習更多知識。

examples.source: Many people like to travel overseas during the summer holidays.
examples.target: 很多人喜歡在暑假期間到海外旅遊。

examples.source: If you work overseas, you can experience a different culture.
examples.target: 如果你到海外工作，你可以體驗不同的文化。

examples.source: My brother is planning to study overseas after he finishes secondary school.
examples.target: 我哥哥計劃在中學畢業後到海外升學。

examples.source: Many people like to travel overseas during the long summer holiday period.
examples.target: 很多人喜歡在長暑假期間到海外旅遊。

examples.source: She often buys clothes from overseas websites because the styles are unique.
examples.target: 她經常在海外網站購買衣服，因為款式很獨特。

examples.source: My cousin is currently studying at an overseas university in the United Kingdom.
examples.target: 我的表親目前正在英國的一所海外大學留學。

examples.source: Many students choose to gain overseas experience by joining a summer exchange program.
examples.target: 許多學生選擇參加暑期交流計劃，以獲取海外經驗。

examples.source: We often buy overseas snacks online because they are difficult to find locally.
examples.target: 我們經常在網上購買海外零食，因為這些零食在本地很難找到。

overshadow.meaning: 使蒙上陰影 / 令...失色

examples.source: Her great success seemed to overshadow her brother's small achievements.
examples.target: 她巨大的成功似乎令她弟弟的小成就失色。

examples.source: The bad weather threatened to overshadow our fun school picnic.
examples.target: 惡劣的天氣令我們的學校旅行蒙上陰影。

examples.source: Do not let one mistake overshadow all your hard work.
examples.target: 不要因為一個錯誤而令你所有的努力失色。

examples.source: The red car tried to overtake the bus on the road.
examples.target: 那輛紅色的車試圖在路上超越那輛巴士。

examples.source: It is dangerous to overtake when there is oncoming traffic.
examples.target: 當有對面來車時，進行超車是非常危險的。

examples.source: She cycled fast to overtake her friend in the park.
examples.target: 她在公園裡騎得很快，想要趕過她的朋友。

overwhelmed.meaning: 充滿情緒的 / 不知所措的

examples.source: She was overwhelmed with joy when she won the competition.
examples.target: 當她贏得比賽時，她感到欣喜若狂。

examples.source: I felt overwhelmed by the kindness of my new classmates.
examples.target: 我被新同學的友善深深感動。

examples.source: The students were overwhelmed with excitement before the school trip.
examples.target: 校外考察前，學生們都感到非常興奮。

overwhelmed.meaning: 不知所措的 / 充滿強烈情感的

examples.source: I felt completely overwhelmed by the large amount of homework this week.
examples.target: 這星期堆積如山的功課令我感到不知所措。

examples.source: She was overwhelmed with joy when she heard the good news today.
examples.target: 當她今天聽到這個好消息時，她感到欣喜若狂。

examples.source: The new student felt overwhelmed by the busy life at our school.
examples.target: 那位新來的同學對我們學校繁忙的生活感到不知所措。

overwhelmed with.meaning: 充滿情緒 / 感到非常...

examples.source: I was overwhelmed with joy when I won the school competition.
examples.target: 當我贏得校際比賽時，我感到欣喜若狂。

examples.source: She was overwhelmed with sadness because her best friend moved away.
examples.target: 因為她最好的朋友搬走了，她感到非常傷心。

examples.source: The students were overwhelmed with excitement before the summer holiday started.
examples.target: 暑假開始前，學生們都感到非常興奮。

overwhelmed with.meaning: 被...充滿 / 因...應接不暇

examples.source: She was overwhelmed with homework before the exam.
examples.target: 考試前，她因功課太多而應接不暇。

examples.source: The team was overwhelmed with messages after the show.
examples.target: 演出後，團隊被訊息充滿，應接不暇。

examples.source: He felt overwhelmed with joy when he won.
examples.target: 他勝出時心中充滿喜悅。

examples.source: The match was cancelled owing to the heavy rain.
examples.target: 由於大雨，比賽被迫取消了。

examples.source: Owing to his hard work, he passed the exam.
examples.target: 由於他努力溫習，他通過了考試。

examples.source: We arrived late owing to the traffic jam.
examples.target: 由於交通擠塞，我們遲到了。

examples.source: The game was cancelled owing to the heavy rain.
examples.target: 由於大雨，比賽取消了。

examples.source: She was late for school owing to the traffic jam.
examples.target: 由於交通擠塞，她上學遲到了。

examples.source: The park is closed owing to the bad weather today.
examples.target: 由於今天天氣惡劣，公園關閉了。

examples.source: I like to eat fresh oyster with a little lemon juice.
examples.target: 我喜歡加一點檸檬汁吃新鮮的蠔。

examples.source: We went to a restaurant to have grilled oyster for dinner.
examples.target: 我們去了一間餐廳吃燒蠔作晚餐。

examples.source: Some people believe that eating oyster is good for your health.
examples.target: 有些人認為吃蠔對健康有益。

examples.source: Eating too much junk food can lead to serious obesity in teenagers.
examples.target: 吃太多垃圾食物可能會導致青少年出現嚴重的肥胖問題。

examples.source: Schools are trying to prevent childhood obesity by promoting healthy eating habits.
examples.target: 學校正透過推廣健康的飲食習慣，來預防兒童肥胖。

examples.source: Regular exercise is a great way to lower the risk of obesity.
examples.target: 恆常運動是降低肥胖風險的好方法。

examples.source: Students must obey the school rules to keep the campus safe and tidy.
examples.target: 學生必須遵守校規，以保持校園安全和整潔。

examples.source: You should obey your parents because they always want the best for you.
examples.target: 你應該聽從父母的話，因為他們總是為你好。

examples.source: The well-trained dog will obey every command given by its owner immediately.
examples.target: 這隻訓練有素的狗會立即服從主人發出的每一道指令。

examples.source: Students are expected to obey the school rules during the academic year.
examples.target: 學生在學年期間必須遵守校規。

examples.source: You should always obey your parents when they give you good advice.
examples.target: 當父母給你好的建議時，你應該要聽從他們。

examples.source: The well-trained dog will obey every command from its owner immediately.
examples.target: 這隻訓練有素的狗會立即服從主人發出的每一個指令。

examples.source: You should try to be objective when you judge this school competition.
examples.target: 你在評判這次校內比賽時，應該嘗試保持客觀。

examples.source: It is important to keep an objective view when reading the news.
examples.target: 閱讀新聞時，保持客觀的觀點是非常重要的。

examples.source: The teacher gave an objective report on the student's academic progress.
examples.target: 老師對該學生的學業進度給出了一份客觀的報告。

examples.source: Our main objective this term is to improve our English speaking skills.
examples.target: 我們這學期的主要目標是提升英語口語能力。

examples.source: She worked hard every day to achieve her objective of winning gold.
examples.target: 她每天努力練習，以達成奪取金牌的目標。

examples.source: The team set a clear objective to finish the project before Friday.
examples.target: 團隊定下了一個清晰的目標，要在星期五前完成計劃。

examples.source: Students have an obligation to complete their homework before the next class.
examples.target: 學生有義務在下一堂課前完成功課。

examples.source: It is our moral obligation to help those who are in need.
examples.target: 我們有道德義務去幫助那些有需要的人。

examples.target: 如果不用考慮下雨，野餐就可以繼續。

examples.source: The injury took him out of the equation.
examples.target: 受傷令他被排除在外。

out of the frying pan and into the fire.meaning: 才脫離一個困境又陷入更糟的困境

examples.source: Changing schools without a plan put him out of the frying pan and into the fire.
examples.target: 沒有計劃就轉校，令他才脫離一個困境又陷入更糟的困境。

examples.source: The quick fix moved us out of the frying pan and into the fire.
examples.target: 快速補救令我們才離開一個問題又跌入更糟情況。

examples.source: The story shows a hero going out of the frying pan and into the fire.
examples.target: 故事描寫主角才脫離一個困境又陷入更糟的困境。

out of the hands of.meaning: 不落入...手中 / 脫離...掌控

examples.source: The rule keeps private data out of the hands of strangers.
examples.target: 這條規則避免私人資料落入陌生人手中。

examples.source: The decision is now out of the hands of the students.
examples.target: 決定現在已脫離學生掌控。

examples.source: The charity keeps money out of the hands of dishonest groups.
examples.target: 慈善機構避免金錢落入不誠實團體手中。

examples.source: The clock is out of whack.
examples.target: 時鐘失準了。

examples.source: My sleep schedule is out of whack after the holiday.
examples.target: 假期後，我的睡眠時間不正常。

examples.source: The figures look out of whack, so check them again.
examples.target: 數字看起來不正常，所以再檢查一次。

out on the town.meaning: 出外玩樂 / 外出消遣

examples.source: They went out on the town after exams.
examples.target: 考試後，他們出外玩樂。

examples.source: Her parents were out on the town for dinner.
examples.target: 她的父母外出消遣吃晚飯。

examples.source: The article describes a night out on the town.
examples.target: 文章描述一晚外出玩樂。

examples.source: He left early so he would not outstay his welcome.
examples.target: 他早點離開，以免逗留太久而不受歡迎。

examples.source: Guests should not outstay their welcome.
examples.target: 客人不應逗留太久而令人不歡迎。

examples.source: The speaker outstayed his welcome with a long speech.
examples.target: 演講者講太久，變得不受歡迎。

examples.source: Over-farming can damage the soil.
examples.target: 過度耕作會破壞泥土。

examples.source: The report links over-farming to lower crop yields.
examples.target: 報告把過度耕作與農作物收成下降聯繫起來。

examples.source: Farmers need methods that avoid over-farming.
examples.target: 農民需要避免過度耕作的方法。

over-idyllic.meaning: 過分理想化的 / 過分美化的

examples.source: The film gives an over-idyllic picture of village life.
examples.target: 電影把鄉村生活描寫得過分理想化。

examples.source: Her essay was over-idyllic and ignored real problems.
examples.target: 她的文章過分美化，忽略了真實問題。

examples.source: The advertisement presents an over-idyllic holiday scene.
examples.target: 廣告呈現過分理想化的假期畫面。

examples.source: The game was too bright and over-stimulating.
examples.target: 遊戲太光猛，而且過度刺激。

examples.source: An over-stimulating classroom can distract children.
examples.target: 過度刺激的課室會令孩子分心。

examples.source: She avoided over-stimulating videos before sleep.
examples.target: 她睡前避免觀看過度刺激的影片。

overcome with joy.meaning: 喜不自勝 / 被喜悅淹沒

examples.source: She was overcome with joy after hearing the news.
examples.target: 她聽到消息後喜不自勝。

examples.source: The team was overcome with joy after winning.
examples.target: 隊伍勝出後被喜悅淹沒。

examples.source: He was overcome with joy when his family arrived.
examples.target: 家人到達時，他喜不自勝。

examples.source: She owes a debt to her first teacher.
examples.target: 她受惠於第一位老師。

examples.source: The writer owes a debt to local culture.
examples.target: 這位作家受惠於本地文化。

examples.source: We owe a debt to the people who helped us.
examples.target: 我們欠幫助過我們的人一份恩情。

examples.source: The town owes its existence to the old railway.
examples.target: 這個小鎮因舊鐵路而存在。

examples.source: The project owes its existence to student volunteers.
examples.target: 這個項目歸功於學生義工。

examples.source: Many traditions owe their existence to local history.
examples.target: 很多傳統因本地歷史而存在。

owe it to.meaning: 有責任為...做 / 欠...應做

examples.source: You owe it to your team to try your best.
examples.target: 你有責任為隊伍盡力。

examples.source: We owe it to students to explain the rule clearly.
examples.target: 我們有責任向學生清楚解釋規則。

examples.source: She owed it to her parents to be honest.
examples.target: 她欠父母一份誠實相待的責任。

owe it to oneself.meaning: 應該為自己做 / 對自己有責任

examples.source: You owe it to yourself to rest after exams.
examples.target: 考試後你應該為自己休息一下。

examples.source: She owed it to herself to speak up.
examples.target: 她對自己有責任說出來。

examples.source: I owe it to myself to keep learning.
examples.target: 我應該為自己繼續學習。

examples.source: I owe my teacher a debt of gratitude.
examples.target: 我對老師深懷感激。

examples.source: The team owed the coach a debt of gratitude.
examples.target: 隊伍對教練深懷感激。

examples.source: She owes her family a debt of gratitude for their support.
examples.target: 她對家人的支持深懷感激。
